section_reviews.heading: MỞ ĐẦU
section_reviews.argument: Research questions, limited project scope and contributions lead into the chapter plan.
section_reviews.evidence: Distinguishes saved historical evidence from public UI observation and fresh experiments not run.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Substantive opening, no numeric performance promise.

section_reviews.heading: Cơ sở lý thuyết và khung phân tích
section_reviews.argument: Connects retrieval, grounding, evaluation layers and OOP to the project questions.
section_reviews.terminology: Technical terms introduced with Vietnamese explanations.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Theory is used to derive analysis criteria, not just define acronyms.

section_reviews.heading: PHÂN TÍCH NGHIỆP VỤ VÀ MÔ HÌNH CHỨC NĂNG
section_reviews.argument: Roles lead to use cases, alternate outcomes, activity/state behavior and acceptance criteria.
section_reviews.evidence: Current route/service evidence; UI observations are separate.
section_reviews.terminology: 61 final paragraph rewrites include all six use cases.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Each operation explains purpose and permission/error consequences.

section_reviews.heading: PHÂN TÍCH VÀ THIẾT KẾ HƯỚNG ĐỐI TƯỢNG
section_reviews.argument: Domain-data relationships precede implementation class responsibilities and maintainability tradeoffs.
section_reviews.evidence: Account/chat/workspace records checked; no ORM/foreign-key invention.
section_reviews.terminology: Logical record and implementation class are explicitly distinguished.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Each new data figure has substantive analysis of ownership, optionality and integrity.

section_reviews.heading: KIẾN TRÚC, DỮ LIỆU, LỰA CHỌN CÔNG NGHỆ VÀ THIẾT KẾ THÀNH PHẦN
section_reviews.argument: Explains why alternatives affect consistency, grounding, capacity and maintenance.
section_reviews.evidence: V3 and legacy configuration snapshots remain separately bounded.
section_reviews.terminology: Narrative recast in Vietnamese; exact store/model identifiers retained for traceability.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Architecture tradeoffs and ingestion risks developed instead of source-file inventories.

section_reviews.heading: KIỂM THỬ, BẢO MẬT VÀ ĐÁNH GIÁ HỆ THỐNG
section_reviews.argument: Separates test success, retrieval quality, answer quality and evidence sufficiency.
section_reviews.evidence: Historical suite/benchmark denominators and non-comparability retained; no fresh-run claim.
section_reviews.terminology: Evaluation prose fully revised, including metric definitions, dates and denominator interpretation; numeric facts and citation fields preserved.
section_reviews.sufficiency: No inference of legal correctness from infrastructure success.

section_reviews.heading: ĐỀ XUẤT CẢI TIẾN VÀ KẾ HOẠCH KIỂM CHỨNG
section_reviews.argument: Prioritizes source integrity and permissions, then evaluation and maintenance.
section_reviews.evidence: Future protocol is explicitly proposed; not described as completed results.
section_reviews.terminology: Technical acceptance plans rewritten as academic reasoning.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Clear reason, method and result boundary for each proposed improvement.

section_reviews.heading: KẾT LUẬN VÀ HƯỚNG PHÁT TRIỂN
section_reviews.argument: Returns to research scope and practical limitations.
section_reviews.evidence: No current-law validity or protected-route execution invented.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Conclusion tied to analyzed evidence and remaining work.
